testcase.name: Scenario: Expand and collapse an extrusion's browser children: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:484:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Expand and collapse an extrusion's browser children ✔ Given a part with an extrusion and its underlying sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the extrusion branch is collapsed in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the extrusion and chooses Expand All Children ✔ Then the extrusion branch displays its sketch child ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user right-clicks the extrusion and chooses Collapse All Children ✔ Then the extrusion branch still displays its direct sketch child ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport
